ayahs.arabicText: تَنْزِیْلُ الْكِتٰبِ مِنَ اللّٰهِ الْعَزِیْزِ الْحَكِیْمِ
ayahs.translation: The revelation of the Qur'an is from Allah, the Exalted in Might, the Wise.

ayahs.arabicText: اِنَّاۤ اَنْزَلْنَاۤ اِلَیْكَ الْكِتٰبَ بِالْحَقِّ فَاعْبُدِ اللّٰهَ مُخْلِصًا لَّهُ الدِّیْنَؕ
ayahs.translation: Indeed, We have sent down to you the Book, [O Muhammad], in truth. So worship Allah, [being] sincere to Him in religion.

ayahs.arabicText: اَلَا لِلّٰهِ الدِّیْنُ الْخَالِصُ١ؕ وَ الَّذِیْنَ اتَّخَذُوْا مِنْ دُوْنِهٖۤ اَوْلِیَآءَ١ۘ مَا نَعْبُدُهُمْ اِلَّا لِیُقَرِّبُوْنَاۤ اِلَى اللّٰهِ زُلْفٰى١ؕ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ یَحْكُمُ بَیْنَهُمْ فِیْ مَا هُمْ فِیْهِ یَخْتَلِفُوْنَ١ؕ۬ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ لَا یَهْدِیْ مَنْ هُوَ كٰذِبٌ كَفَّارٌ
ayahs.translation: Unquestionably, for Allah is the pure religion. And those who take protectors besides Him [say], "We only worship them that they may bring us nearer to Allah in position." Indeed, Allah will judge between them concerning that over which they differ. Indeed, Allah does not guide he who is a liar and [confirmed] disbeliever.

ayahs.arabicText: لَوْ اَرَادَ اللّٰهُ اَنْ یَّتَّخِذَ وَلَدًا لَّاصْطَفٰى مِمَّا یَخْلُقُ مَا یَشَآءُ١ۙ سُبْحٰنَهٗ١ؕ هُوَ اللّٰهُ الْوَاحِدُ الْقَهَّارُ
ayahs.translation: If Allah had intended to take a son, He could have chosen from what He creates whatever He willed. Exalted is He; He is Allah, the One, the Prevailing.

ayahs.arabicText: خَلَقَ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَ الْاَرْضَ بِالْحَقِّ١ۚ یُكَوِّرُ الَّیْلَ عَلَى النَّهَارِ وَ یُكَوِّرُ النَّهَارَ عَلَى الَّیْلِ وَ سَخَّرَ الشَّمْسَ وَ الْقَمَرَ١ؕ كُلٌّ یَّجْرِیْ لِاَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى١ؕ اَلَا هُوَ الْعَزِیْزُ الْغَفَّارُ
ayahs.translation: He created the heavens and earth in truth. He wraps the night over the day and wraps the day over the night and has subjected the sun and the moon, each running [its course] for a specified term. Unquestionably, He is the Exalted in Might, the Perpetual Forgiver.

ayahs.arabicText: خَلَقَكُمْ مِّنْ نَّفْسٍ وَّاحِدَةٍ ثُمَّ جَعَلَ مِنْهَا زَوْجَهَا وَ اَنْزَلَ لَكُمْ مِّنَ الْاَنْعَامِ ثَمٰنِیَةَ اَزْوَاجٍ١ؕ یَخْلُقُكُمْ فِیْ بُطُوْنِ اُمَّهٰتِكُمْ خَلْقًا مِّنْۢ بَعْدِ خَلْقٍ فِیْ ظُلُمٰتٍ ثَلٰثٍ١ؕ ذٰلِكُمُ اللّٰهُ رَبُّكُمْ لَهُ الْمُلْكُ١ؕ لَاۤ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا هُوَ١ۚ فَاَنّٰى تُصْرَفُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: He created you from one soul. Then He made from it its mate, and He produced for you from the grazing livestock eight mates. He creates you in the wombs of your mothers, creation after creation, within three darknesses. That is Allah, your Lord; to Him belongs dominion. There is no deity except Him, so how are you averted?

ayahs.arabicText: اِنْ تَكْفُرُوْا فَاِنَّ اللّٰهَ غَنِیٌّ عَنْكُمْ١۫ وَ لَا یَرْضٰى لِعِبَادِهِ الْكُفْرَ١ۚ وَ اِنْ تَشْكُرُوْا یَرْضَهُ لَكُمْ١ؕ وَ لَا تَزِرُ وَازِرَةٌ وِّزْرَ اُخْرٰى١ؕ ثُمَّ اِلٰى رَبِّكُمْ مَّرْجِعُكُمْ فَیُنَبِّئُكُمْ بِمَا كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُوْنَ١ؕ اِنَّهٗ عَلِیْمٌۢ بِذَاتِ الصُّدُوْرِ
ayahs.translation: If you disbelieve - indeed, Allah is Free from need of you. And He does not approve for His servants disbelief. And if you are grateful, He approves it for you; and no bearer of burdens will bear the burden of another. Then to your Lord is your return, and He will inform you about what you used to do. Indeed, He is Knowing of that within the breasts.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اِذَا مَسَّ الْاِنْسَانَ ضُرٌّ دَعَا رَبَّهٗ مُنِیْبًا اِلَیْهِ ثُمَّ اِذَا خَوَّلَهٗ نِعْمَةً مِّنْهُ نَسِیَ مَا كَانَ یَدْعُوْۤا اِلَیْهِ مِنْ قَبْلُ وَ جَعَلَ لِلّٰهِ اَنْدَادًا لِّیُضِلَّ عَنْ سَبِیْلِهٖ١ؕ قُلْ تَمَتَّعْ بِكُفْرِكَ قَلِیْلًا١ۖۗ اِنَّكَ مِنْ اَصْحٰبِ النَّارِ
ayahs.translation: And when adversity touches man, he calls upon his Lord, turning to Him [alone]; then when He bestows on him a favor from Himself, he forgets Him whom he called upon before, and he attributes to Allah equals to mislead [people] from His way. Say, "Enjoy your disbelief for a little; indeed, you are of the companions of the Fire."

ayahs.arabicText: اَمَّنْ هُوَ قَانِتٌ اٰنَآءَ الَّیْلِ سَاجِدًا وَّ قَآئِمًا یَّحْذَرُ الْاٰخِرَةَ وَ یَرْجُوْا رَحْمَةَ رَبِّهٖ١ؕ قُلْ هَلْ یَسْتَوِی الَّذِیْنَ یَعْلَمُوْنَ وَ الَّذِیْنَ لَا یَعْلَمُوْنَ١ؕ اِنَّمَا یَتَذَكَّرُ اُولُوا الْاَلْبَابِ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: Is one who is devoutly obedient during periods of the night, prostrating and standing [in prayer], fearing the Hereafter and hoping for the mercy of his Lord, [like one who does not]? Say, "Are those who know equal to those who do not know?" Only they will remember [who are] people of understanding.

ayahs.arabicText: قُلْ یٰعِبَادِ الَّذِیْنَ اٰمَنُوا اتَّقُوْا رَبَّكُمْ١ؕ لِلَّذِیْنَ اَحْسَنُوْا فِیْ هٰذِهِ الدُّنْیَا حَسَنَةٌ١ؕ وَ اَرْضُ اللّٰهِ وَاسِعَةٌ١ؕ اِنَّمَا یُوَفَّى الصّٰبِرُوْنَ اَجْرَهُمْ بِغَیْرِ حِسَابٍ
ayahs.translation: Say, "O My servants who have believed, fear your Lord. For those who do good in this world is good, and the earth of Allah is spacious. Indeed, the patient will be given their reward without account."

ayahs.arabicText: قُلْ اِنِّیْۤ اُمِرْتُ اَنْ اَعْبُدَ اللّٰهَ مُخْلِصًا لَّهُ الدِّیْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: Say, [O Muhammad], "Indeed, I have been commanded to worship Allah, [being] sincere to Him in religion.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اُمِرْتُ لِاَنْ اَكُوْنَ اَوَّلَ الْمُسْلِمِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: And I have been commanded to be the first [among you] of the Muslims."

ayahs.arabicText: قُلْ اِنِّیْۤ اَخَافُ اِنْ عَصَیْتُ رَبِّیْ عَذَابَ یَوْمٍ عَظِیْمٍ
ayahs.translation: Say, "Indeed I fear, if I should disobey my Lord, the punishment of a tremendous Day."

ayahs.arabicText: قُلِ اللّٰهَ اَعْبُدُ مُخْلِصًا لَّهٗ دِیْنِیْۙ
ayahs.translation: Say, "Allah [alone] do I worship, sincere to Him in my religion,

ayahs.arabicText: فَاعْبُدُوْا مَا شِئْتُمْ مِّنْ دُوْنِهٖ١ؕ قُلْ اِنَّ الْخٰسِرِیْنَ الَّذِیْنَ خَسِرُوْۤا اَنْفُسَهُمْ وَ اَهْلِیْهِمْ یَوْمَ الْقِیٰمَةِ١ؕ اَلَا ذٰلِكَ هُوَ الْخُسْرَانُ الْمُبِیْنُ
ayahs.translation: So worship what you will besides Him." Say, "Indeed, the losers are the ones who will lose themselves and their families on the Day of Resurrection. Unquestionably, that is the manifest loss."

ayahs.arabicText: لَهُمْ مِّنْ فَوْقِهِمْ ظُلَلٌ مِّنَ النَّارِ وَ مِنْ تَحْتِهِمْ ظُلَلٌ١ؕ ذٰلِكَ یُخَوِّفُ اللّٰهُ بِهٖ عِبَادَهٗ١ؕ یٰعِبَادِ فَاتَّقُوْنِ
ayahs.translation: They will have canopies of fire above them and below them, canopies. By that Allah threatens His servants. O My servants, then fear Me.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ الَّذِیْنَ اجْتَنَبُوا الطَّاغُوْتَ اَنْ یَّعْبُدُوْهَا وَ اَنَابُوْۤا اِلَى اللّٰهِ لَهُمُ الْبُشْرٰى١ۚ فَبَشِّرْ عِبَادِۙ
ayahs.translation: But those who have avoided Taghut, lest they worship it, and turned back to Allah - for them are good tidings. So give good tidings to My servants

ayahs.arabicText: الَّذِیْنَ یَسْتَمِعُوْنَ الْقَوْلَ فَیَتَّبِعُوْنَ اَحْسَنَهٗ١ؕ اُولٰٓئِكَ الَّذِیْنَ هَدٰىهُمُ اللّٰهُ وَ اُولٰٓئِكَ هُمْ اُولُوا الْاَلْبَابِ
ayahs.translation: Who listen to speech and follow the best of it. Those are the ones Allah has guided, and those are people of understanding.

ayahs.arabicText: اَفَمَنْ حَقَّ عَلَیْهِ كَلِمَةُ الْعَذَابِ١ؕ اَفَاَنْتَ تُنْقِذُ مَنْ فِی النَّارِۚ
ayahs.translation: Then, is one who has deserved the decree of punishment [to be guided]? Then, can you save one who is in the Fire?

ayahs.arabicText: لٰكِنِ الَّذِیْنَ اتَّقَوْا رَبَّهُمْ لَهُمْ غُرَفٌ مِّنْ فَوْقِهَا غُرَفٌ مَّبْنِیَّةٌ١ۙ تَجْرِیْ مِنْ تَحْتِهَا الْاَنْهٰرُ١ؕ۬ وَعْدَ اللّٰهِ١ؕ لَا یُخْلِفُ اللّٰهُ الْمِیْعَادَ
ayahs.translation: But those who have feared their Lord - for them are chambers, above them chambers built high, beneath which rivers flow. [This is] the promise of Allah. Allah does not fail in [His] promise.

ayahs.arabicText: اَلَمْ تَرَ اَنَّ اللّٰهَ اَنْزَلَ مِنَ السَّمَآءِ مَآءً فَسَلَكَهٗ یَنَابِیْعَ فِی الْاَرْضِ ثُمَّ یُخْرِجُ بِهٖ زَرْعًا مُّخْتَلِفًا اَلْوَانُهٗ ثُمَّ یَهِیْجُ فَتَرٰىهُ مُصْفَرًّا ثُمَّ یَجْعَلُهٗ حُطَامًا١ؕ اِنَّ فِیْ ذٰلِكَ لَذِكْرٰى لِاُولِی الْاَلْبَابِ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: Do you not see that Allah sends down rain from the sky and makes it flow as springs [and rivers] in the earth; then He produces thereby crops of varying colors; then they dry and you see them turned yellow; then He makes them [scattered] debris. Indeed in that is a reminder for those of understanding.

ayahs.arabicText: اَفَمَنْ شَرَحَ اللّٰهُ صَدْرَهٗ لِلْاِسْلَامِ فَهُوَ عَلٰى نُوْرٍ مِّنْ رَّبِّهٖ١ؕ فَوَیْلٌ لِّلْقٰسِیَةِ قُلُوْبُهُمْ مِّنْ ذِكْرِ اللّٰهِ١ؕ اُولٰٓئِكَ فِیْ ضَلٰلٍ مُّبِیْنٍ
ayahs.translation: So is one whose breast Allah has expanded to [accept] Islam and he is upon a light from his Lord [like one whose heart rejects it]? Then woe to those whose hearts are hardened against the remembrance of Allah. Those are in manifest error.

ayahs.arabicText: اَللّٰهُ نَزَّلَ اَحْسَنَ الْحَدِیْثِ كِتٰبًا مُّتَشَابِهًا مَّثَانِیَ١ۖۗ تَقْشَعِرُّ مِنْهُ جُلُوْدُ الَّذِیْنَ یَخْشَوْنَ رَبَّهُمْ١ۚ ثُمَّ تَلِیْنُ جُلُوْدُهُمْ وَ قُلُوْبُهُمْ اِلٰى ذِكْرِ اللّٰهِ١ؕ ذٰلِكَ هُدَى اللّٰهِ یَهْدِیْ بِهٖ مَنْ یَّشَآءُ١ؕ وَ مَنْ یُّضْلِلِ اللّٰهُ فَمَا لَهٗ مِنْ هَادٍ
ayahs.translation: Allah has sent down the best statement: a consistent Book wherein is reiteration. The skins shiver therefrom of those who fear their Lord; then their skins and their hearts relax at the remembrance of Allah. That is the guidance of Allah by which He guides whom He wills. And one whom Allah leaves astray - for him there is no guide.

ayahs.arabicText: اَفَمَنْ یَّتَّقِیْ بِوَجْهِهٖ سُوْٓءَ الْعَذَابِ یَوْمَ الْقِیٰمَةِ١ؕ وَ قِیْلَ لِلظّٰلِمِیْنَ ذُوْقُوْا مَا كُنْتُمْ تَكْسِبُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Then is he who will shield with his face the worst of the punishment on the Day of Resurrection [like one secure from it]? And it will be said to the wrongdoers, "Taste what you used to earn."

ayahs.arabicText: كَذَّبَ الَّذِیْنَ مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ فَاَتٰىهُمُ الْعَذَابُ مِنْ حَیْثُ لَا یَشْعُرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Those before them denied, and punishment came upon them from where they did not perceive.

ayahs.arabicText: فَاَذَاقَهُمُ اللّٰهُ الْخِزْیَ فِی الْحَیٰوةِ الدُّنْیَا١ۚ وَ لَعَذَابُ الْاٰخِرَةِ اَكْبَرُ١ۘ لَوْ كَانُوْا یَعْلَمُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: So Allah made them taste disgrace in worldly life. But the punishment of the Hereafter is greater, if they only knew.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَقَدْ ضَرَبْنَا لِلنَّاسِ فِیْ هٰذَا الْقُرْاٰنِ مِنْ كُلِّ مَثَلٍ لَّعَلَّهُمْ یَتَذَكَّرُوْنَۚ
ayahs.translation: And We have certainly presented for the people in this Qur'an from every [kind of] example - that they might remember.

ayahs.arabicText: قُرْاٰنًا عَرَبِیًّا غَیْرَ ذِیْ عِوَجٍ لَّعَلَّهُمْ یَتَّقُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: [It is] an Arabic Qur'an, without any deviance that they might become righteous.

ayahs.arabicText: ضَرَبَ اللّٰهُ مَثَلًا رَّجُلًا فِیْهِ شُرَكَآءُ مُتَشٰكِسُوْنَ وَ رَجُلًا سَلَمًا لِّرَجُلٍ١ؕ هَلْ یَسْتَوِیٰنِ مَثَلًا١ؕ اَلْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ١ۚ بَلْ اَكْثَرُهُمْ لَا یَعْلَمُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Allah presents an example: a slave owned by quarreling partners and another belonging exclusively to one man - are they equal in comparison? Praise be to Allah! But most of them do not know.

ayahs.arabicText: اِنَّكَ مَیِّتٌ وَّ اِنَّهُمْ مَّیِّتُوْنَ٘
ayahs.translation: Indeed, you are to die, and indeed, they are to die.

ayahs.arabicText: ثُمَّ اِنَّكُمْ یَوْمَ الْقِیٰمَةِ عِنْدَ رَبِّكُمْ تَخْتَصِمُوْنَ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: Then indeed you, on the Day of Resurrection, before your Lord, will dispute.

ayahs.arabicText: فَمَنْ اَظْلَمُ مِمَّنْ كَذَبَ عَلَى اللّٰهِ وَ كَذَّبَ بِالصِّدْقِ اِذْ جَآءَهٗ١ؕ اَلَیْسَ فِیْ جَهَنَّمَ مَثْوًى لِّلْكٰفِرِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: So who is more unjust than one who lies about Allah and denies the truth when it has come to him? Is there not in Hell a residence for the disbelievers?

ayahs.arabicText: وَ الَّذِیْ جَآءَ بِالصِّدْقِ وَ صَدَّقَ بِهٖۤ اُولٰٓئِكَ هُمُ الْمُتَّقُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: And the one who has brought the truth and [they who] believed in it - those are the righteous.

ayahs.arabicText: لَهُمْ مَّا یَشَآءُوْنَ عِنْدَ رَبِّهِمْ١ؕ ذٰلِكَ جَزٰٓؤُا الْمُحْسِنِیْنَۚۖ
ayahs.translation: They will have whatever they desire with their Lord. That is the reward of the doers of good -

ayahs.arabicText: لِیُكَفِّرَ اللّٰهُ عَنْهُمْ اَسْوَاَ الَّذِیْ عَمِلُوْا وَ یَجْزِیَهُمْ اَجْرَهُمْ بِاَحْسَنِ الَّذِیْ كَانُوْا یَعْمَلُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: That Allah may remove from them the worst of what they did and reward them their due for the best of what they used to do.

ayahs.arabicText: اَلَیْسَ اللّٰهُ بِكَافٍ عَبْدَهٗ١ؕ وَ یُخَوِّفُوْنَكَ بِالَّذِیْنَ مِنْ دُوْنِهٖ١ؕ وَ مَنْ یُّضْلِلِ اللّٰهُ فَمَا لَهٗ مِنْ هَادٍۚ
ayahs.translation: Is not Allah sufficient for His Servant [Prophet Muhammad]? And [yet], they threaten you with those [they worship] other than Him. And whoever Allah leaves astray - for him there is no guide.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ مَنْ یَّهْدِ اللّٰهُ فَمَا لَهٗ مِنْ مُّضِلٍّ١ؕ اَلَیْسَ اللّٰهُ بِعَزِیْزٍ ذِی انْتِقَامٍ
ayahs.translation: And whoever Allah guides - for him there is no misleader. Is not Allah Exalted in Might and Owner of Retribution?

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَئِنْ سَاَلْتَهُمْ مَّنْ خَلَقَ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَ الْاَرْضَ لَیَقُوْلُنَّ اللّٰهُ١ؕ قُلْ اَفَرَءَیْتُمْ مَّا تَدْعُوْنَ مِنْ دُوْنِ اللّٰهِ اِنْ اَرَادَنِیَ اللّٰهُ بِضُرٍّ هَلْ هُنَّ كٰشِفٰتُ ضُرِّهٖۤ اَوْ اَرَادَنِیْ بِرَحْمَةٍ هَلْ هُنَّ مُمْسِكٰتُ رَحْمَتِهٖ١ؕ قُلْ حَسْبِیَ اللّٰهُ١ؕ عَلَیْهِ یَتَوَكَّلُ الْمُتَوَكِّلُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: And if you asked them, "Who created the heavens and the earth?" they would surely say, "Allah." Say, "Then have you considered what you invoke besides Allah? If Allah intended me harm, are they removers of His harm; or if He intended me mercy, are they withholders of His mercy?" Say, "Sufficient for me is Allah; upon Him [alone] rely the [wise] reliers."

ayahs.arabicText: قُلْ یٰقَوْمِ اعْمَلُوْا عَلٰى مَكَانَتِكُمْ اِنِّیْ عَامِلٌ١ۚ فَسَوْفَ تَعْلَمُوْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: Say, "O my people, work according to your position, [for] indeed, I am working; and you are going to know

ayahs.arabicText: مَنْ یَّاْتِیْهِ عَذَابٌ یُّخْزِیْهِ وَ یَحِلُّ عَلَیْهِ عَذَابٌ مُّقِیْمٌ
ayahs.translation: To whom will come a torment disgracing him and on whom will descend an enduring punishment."

ayahs.arabicText: اِنَّاۤ اَنْزَلْنَا عَلَیْكَ الْكِتٰبَ لِلنَّاسِ بِالْحَقِّ١ۚ فَمَنِ اهْتَدٰى فَلِنَفْسِهٖ١ۚ وَ مَنْ ضَلَّ فَاِنَّمَا یَضِلُّ عَلَیْهَا١ۚ وَ مَاۤ اَنْتَ عَلَیْهِمْ بِوَكِیْلٍ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: Indeed, We sent down to you the Book for the people in truth. So whoever is guided - it is for [the benefit of] his soul; and whoever goes astray only goes astray to its detriment. And you are not a manager over them.

ayahs.arabicText: اَللّٰهُ یَتَوَفَّى الْاَنْفُسَ حِیْنَ مَوْتِهَا وَ الَّتِیْ لَمْ تَمُتْ فِیْ مَنَامِهَا١ۚ فَیُمْسِكُ الَّتِیْ قَضٰى عَلَیْهَا الْمَوْتَ وَ یُرْسِلُ الْاُخْرٰۤى اِلٰۤى اَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى١ؕ اِنَّ فِیْ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰیٰتٍ لِّقَوْمٍ یَّتَفَكَّرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Allah takes the souls at the time of their death, and those that do not die [He takes] during their sleep. Then He keeps those for which He has decreed death and releases the others for a specified term. Indeed in that are signs for a people who give thought.

ayahs.arabicText: اَمِ اتَّخَذُوْا مِنْ دُوْنِ اللّٰهِ شُفَعَآءَ١ؕ قُلْ اَوَ لَوْ كَانُوْا لَا یَمْلِكُوْنَ شَیْئًا وَّ لَا یَعْقِلُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Or have they taken other than Allah as intercessors? Say, "Even though they do not possess [power over] anything, nor do they reason?"

ayahs.arabicText: قُلْ لِّلّٰهِ الشَّفَاعَةُ جَمِیْعًا١ؕ لَهٗ مُلْكُ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَ الْاَرْضِ١ؕ ثُمَّ اِلَیْهِ تُرْجَعُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Say, "To Allah belongs [the right to allow] intercession entirely. To Him belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth. Then to Him you will be returned."

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اِذَا ذُكِرَ اللّٰهُ وَحْدَهُ اشْمَاَزَّتْ قُلُوْبُ الَّذِیْنَ لَا یُؤْمِنُوْنَ بِالْاٰخِرَةِ١ۚ وَ اِذَا ذُكِرَ الَّذِیْنَ مِنْ دُوْنِهٖۤ اِذَا هُمْ یَسْتَبْشِرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: And when Allah is mentioned alone, the hearts of those who do not believe in the Hereafter shrink with aversion, but when those [worshipped] other than Him are mentioned, immediately they rejoice.

ayahs.arabicText: قُلِ اللّٰهُمَّ فَاطِرَ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَ الْاَرْضِ عٰلِمَ الْغَیْبِ وَ الشَّهَادَةِ اَنْتَ تَحْكُمُ بَیْنَ عِبَادِكَ فِیْ مَا كَانُوْا فِیْهِ یَخْتَلِفُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Say, "O Allah, Creator of the heavens and the earth, Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, You will judge between your servants concerning that over which they used to differ."

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَوْ اَنَّ لِلَّذِیْنَ ظَلَمُوْا مَا فِی الْاَرْضِ جَمِیْعًا وَّ مِثْلَهٗ مَعَهٗ لَافْتَدَوْا بِهٖ مِنْ سُوْٓءِ الْعَذَابِ یَوْمَ الْقِیٰمَةِ١ؕ وَ بَدَا لَهُمْ مِّنَ اللّٰهِ مَا لَمْ یَكُوْنُوْا یَحْتَسِبُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: And if those who did wrong had all that is in the earth entirely and the like of it with it, they would [attempt to] ransom themselves thereby from the worst of the punishment on the Day of Resurrection. And there will appear to them from Allah that which they had not taken into account.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ بَدَا لَهُمْ سَیِّاٰتُ مَا كَسَبُوْا وَ حَاقَ بِهِمْ مَّا كَانُوْا بِهٖ یَسْتَهْزِءُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: And there will appear to them the evils they had earned, and they will be enveloped by what they used to ridicule.

ayahs.arabicText: فَاِذَا مَسَّ الْاِنْسَانَ ضُرٌّ دَعَانَا١٘ ثُمَّ اِذَا خَوَّلْنٰهُ نِعْمَةً مِّنَّا١ۙ قَالَ اِنَّمَاۤ اُوْتِیْتُهٗ عَلٰى عِلْمٍ١ؕ بَلْ هِیَ فِتْنَةٌ وَّ لٰكِنَّ اَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا یَعْلَمُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: And when adversity touches man, he calls upon Us; then when We bestow on him a favor from Us, he says, "I have only been given it because of [my] knowledge." Rather, it is a trial, but most of them do not know.

ayahs.arabicText: قَدْ قَالَهَا الَّذِیْنَ مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ فَمَاۤ اَغْنٰى عَنْهُمْ مَّا كَانُوْا یَكْسِبُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Those before them had already said it, but they were not availed by what they used to earn.

ayahs.arabicText: فَاَصَابَهُمْ سَیِّاٰتُ مَا كَسَبُوْا١ؕ وَ الَّذِیْنَ ظَلَمُوْا مِنْ هٰۤؤُلَآءِ سَیُصِیْبُهُمْ سَیِّاٰتُ مَا كَسَبُوْا١ۙ وَ مَا هُمْ بِمُعْجِزِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: And the evil consequences of what they earned struck them. And those who have wronged of these [people] will be afflicted by the evil consequences of what they earned; and they will not cause failure.

ayahs.arabicText: اَوَ لَمْ یَعْلَمُوْۤا اَنَّ اللّٰهَ یَبْسُطُ الرِّزْقَ لِمَنْ یَّشَآءُ وَ یَقْدِرُ١ؕ اِنَّ فِیْ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰیٰتٍ لِّقَوْمٍ یُّؤْمِنُوْنَ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: Do they not know that Allah extends provision for whom He wills and restricts [it]? Indeed in that are signs for a people who believe.

ayahs.arabicText: قُلْ یٰعِبَادِیَ الَّذِیْنَ اَسْرَفُوْا عَلٰۤى اَنْفُسِهِمْ لَا تَقْنَطُوْا مِنْ رَّحْمَةِ اللّٰهِ١ؕ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ یَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوْبَ جَمِیْعًا١ؕ اِنَّهٗ هُوَ الْغَفُوْرُ الرَّحِیْمُ
ayahs.translation: Say, "O My servants who have transgressed against themselves [by sinning], do not despair of the mercy of Allah. Indeed, Allah forgives all sins. Indeed, it is He who is the Forgiving, the Merciful."

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اَنِیْبُوْۤا اِلٰى رَبِّكُمْ وَ اَسْلِمُوْا لَهٗ مِنْ قَبْلِ اَنْ یَّاْتِیَكُمُ الْعَذَابُ ثُمَّ لَا تُنْصَرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: And return [in repentance] to your Lord and submit to Him before the punishment comes upon you; then you will not be helped.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اتَّبِعُوْۤا اَحْسَنَ مَاۤ اُنْزِلَ اِلَیْكُمْ مِّنْ رَّبِّكُمْ مِّنْ قَبْلِ اَنْ یَّاْتِیَكُمُ الْعَذَابُ بَغْتَةً وَّ اَنْتُمْ لَا تَشْعُرُوْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: And follow the best of what was revealed to you from your Lord before the punishment comes upon you suddenly while you do not perceive,

ayahs.arabicText: اَنْ تَقُوْلَ نَفْسٌ یّٰحَسْرَتٰى عَلٰى مَا فَرَّطْتُّ فِیْ جَنْۢبِ اللّٰهِ وَ اِنْ كُنْتُ لَمِنَ السّٰخِرِیْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: Lest a soul should say, "Oh [how great is] my regret over what I neglected in regard to Allah and that I was among the mockers."

ayahs.arabicText: اَوْ تَقُوْلَ لَوْ اَنَّ اللّٰهَ هَدٰىنِیْ لَكُنْتُ مِنَ الْمُتَّقِیْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: Or [lest] it say, "If only Allah had guided me, I would have been among the righteous."

ayahs.arabicText: اَوْ تَقُوْلَ حِیْنَ تَرَى الْعَذَابَ لَوْ اَنَّ لِیْ كَرَّةً فَاَكُوْنَ مِنَ الْمُحْسِنِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: Or [lest] it say when it sees the punishment, "If only I had another turn so I could be among the doers of good."

ayahs.arabicText: بَلٰى قَدْ جَآءَتْكَ اٰیٰتِیْ فَكَذَّبْتَ بِهَا وَ اسْتَكْبَرْتَ وَ كُنْتَ مِنَ الْكٰفِرِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: But yes, there had come to you My verses, but you denied them and were arrogant, and you were among the disbelievers.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ یَوْمَ الْقِیٰمَةِ تَرَى الَّذِیْنَ كَذَبُوْا عَلَى اللّٰهِ وُجُوْهُهُمْ مُّسْوَدَّةٌ١ؕ اَلَیْسَ فِیْ جَهَنَّمَ مَثْوًى لِّلْمُتَكَبِّرِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: And on the Day of Resurrection you will see those who lied about Allah [with] their faces blackened. Is there not in Hell a residence for the arrogant?

ayahs.arabicText: وَ یُنَجِّی اللّٰهُ الَّذِیْنَ اتَّقَوْا بِمَفَازَتِهِمْ١٘ لَا یَمَسُّهُمُ السُّوْٓءُ وَ لَا هُمْ یَحْزَنُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: And Allah will save those who feared Him by their attainment; no evil will touch them, nor will they grieve.

ayahs.arabicText: اَللّٰهُ خَالِقُ كُلِّ شَیْءٍ١٘ وَّ هُوَ عَلٰى كُلِّ شَیْءٍ وَّكِیْلٌ
ayahs.translation: Allah is the Creator of all things, and He is, over all things, Disposer of affairs.

ayahs.arabicText: لَهٗ مَقَالِیْدُ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَ الْاَرْضِ١ؕ وَ الَّذِیْنَ كَفَرُوْا بِاٰیٰتِ اللّٰهِ اُولٰٓئِكَ هُمُ الْخٰسِرُوْنَ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: To Him belong the keys of the heavens and the earth. And they who disbelieve in the verses of Allah - it is those who are the losers.

ayahs.arabicText: قُلْ اَفَغَیْرَ اللّٰهِ تَاْمُرُوْٓنِّیْۤ اَعْبُدُ اَیُّهَا الْجٰهِلُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Say, [O Muhammad], "Is it other than Allah that you order me to worship, O ignorant ones?"

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَقَدْ اُوْحِیَ اِلَیْكَ وَ اِلَى الَّذِیْنَ مِنْ قَبْلِكَ١ۚ لَئِنْ اَشْرَكْتَ لَیَحْبَطَنَّ عَمَلُكَ وَ لَتَكُوْنَنَّ مِنَ الْخٰسِرِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: And it was already revealed to you and to those before you that if you should associate [anything] with Allah, your work would surely become worthless, and you would surely be among the losers."

ayahs.arabicText: بَلِ اللّٰهَ فَاعْبُدْ وَ كُنْ مِّنَ الشّٰكِرِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: Rather, worship [only] Allah and be among the grateful.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ مَا قَدَرُوا اللّٰهَ حَقَّ قَدْرِهٖ١ۖۗ وَ الْاَرْضُ جَمِیْعًا قَبْضَتُهٗ یَوْمَ الْقِیٰمَةِ وَ السَّمٰوٰتُ مَطْوِیّٰتٌۢ بِیَمِیْنِهٖ١ؕ سُبْحٰنَهٗ وَ تَعٰلٰى عَمَّا یُشْرِكُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: They have not appraised Allah with true appraisal, while the earth entirely will be [within] His grip on the Day of Resurrection, and the heavens will be folded in His right hand. Exalted is He and high above what they associate with Him.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ نُفِخَ فِی الصُّوْرِ فَصَعِقَ مَنْ فِی السَّمٰوٰتِ وَ مَنْ فِی الْاَرْضِ اِلَّا مَنْ شَآءَ اللّٰهُ١ؕ ثُمَّ نُفِخَ فِیْهِ اُخْرٰى فَاِذَا هُمْ قِیَامٌ یَّنْظُرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: And the Horn will be blown, and whoever is in the heavens and whoever is on the earth will fall dead except whom Allah wills. Then it will be blown again, and at once they will be standing, looking on.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اَشْرَقَتِ الْاَرْضُ بِنُوْرِ رَبِّهَا وَ وُضِعَ الْكِتٰبُ وَ جِایْٓءَ بِالنَّبِیّٖنَ وَ الشُّهَدَآءِ وَ قُضِیَ بَیْنَهُمْ بِالْحَقِّ وَ هُمْ لَا یُظْلَمُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: And the earth will shine with the light of its Lord, and the record [of deeds] will be placed, and the prophets and the witnesses will be brought, and it will be judged between them in truth, and they will not be wronged.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ وُفِّیَتْ كُلُّ نَفْسٍ مَّا عَمِلَتْ وَ هُوَ اَعْلَمُ بِمَا یَفْعَلُوْنَ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: And every soul will be fully compensated [for] what it did; and He is most knowing of what they do.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ سِیْقَ الَّذِیْنَ كَفَرُوْۤا اِلٰى جَهَنَّمَ زُمَرًا١ؕ حَتّٰۤى اِذَا جَآءُوْهَا فُتِحَتْ اَبْوَابُهَا وَ قَالَ لَهُمْ خَزَنَتُهَاۤ اَلَمْ یَاْتِكُمْ رُسُلٌ مِّنْكُمْ یَتْلُوْنَ عَلَیْكُمْ اٰیٰتِ رَبِّكُمْ وَ یُنْذِرُوْنَكُمْ لِقَآءَ یَوْمِكُمْ هٰذَا١ؕ قَالُوْا بَلٰى وَ لٰكِنْ حَقَّتْ كَلِمَةُ الْعَذَابِ عَلَى الْكٰفِرِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: And those who disbelieved will be driven to Hell in groups until, when they reach it, its gates are opened and its keepers will say, "Did there not come to you messengers from yourselves, reciting to you the verses of your Lord and warning you of the meeting of this Day of yours?" They will say, "Yes, but the word of punishment has come into effect upon the disbelievers.

ayahs.arabicText: قِیْلَ ادْخُلُوْۤا اَبْوَابَ جَهَنَّمَ خٰلِدِیْنَ فِیْهَا١ۚ فَبِئْسَ مَثْوَى الْمُتَكَبِّرِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: [To them] it will be said, "Enter the gates of Hell to abide eternally therein, and wretched is the residence of the arrogant."

ayahs.arabicText: وَ سِیْقَ الَّذِیْنَ اتَّقَوْا رَبَّهُمْ اِلَى الْجَنَّةِ زُمَرًا١ؕ حَتّٰۤى اِذَا جَآءُوْهَا وَ فُتِحَتْ اَبْوَابُهَا وَ قَالَ لَهُمْ خَزَنَتُهَا سَلٰمٌ عَلَیْكُمْ طِبْتُمْ فَادْخُلُوْهَا خٰلِدِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: But those who feared their Lord will be driven to Paradise in groups until, when they reach it while its gates have been opened and its keepers say, "Peace be upon you; you have become pure; so enter it to abide eternally therein," [they will enter].

ayahs.arabicText: وَ قَالُوا الْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ الَّذِیْ صَدَقَنَا وَعْدَهٗ وَ اَوْرَثَنَا الْاَرْضَ نَتَبَوَّاُ مِنَ الْجَنَّةِ حَیْثُ نَشَآءُ١ۚ فَنِعْمَ اَجْرُ الْعٰمِلِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: And they will say, "Praise to Allah, who has fulfilled for us His promise and made us inherit the earth [so] we may settle in Paradise wherever we will. And excellent is the reward of [righteous] workers."

ayahs.arabicText: وَ تَرَى الْمَلٰٓئِكَةَ حَآفِّیْنَ مِنْ حَوْلِ الْعَرْشِ یُسَبِّحُوْنَ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّهِمْ١ۚ وَ قُضِیَ بَیْنَهُمْ بِالْحَقِّ وَ قِیْلَ الْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ رَبِّ الْعٰلَمِیْنَ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: And you will see the angels surrounding the Throne, exalting [Allah] with praise of their Lord. And it will be judged between them in truth, and it will be said, "[All] praise to Allah, Lord of the worlds."
